title: Kafka east acl: grant then revoke
description: Grants READ/WRITE/DESCRIBE on topic * to a demo principal (StandardAuthorizer), lists it, then revokes -- proving enforcement is live.

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: the principal appears with ALLOW READ/WRITE/DESCRIBE; a follow-up revoke clears it

whatProves: acl enforces via the KRaft StandardAuthorizer enabled in role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer.tf.
